turnaround_reason: ZoomInfo (reticker GTM) collapsed from ~$12 to ~$4 as growth stalled to ~1% and customers cited 'AI/agentic confusion' — the fear that internal AI tools and consumption models erode its seat-based go-to-market data business. It might recover if the pivot to consumption pricing + GTM.AI stabilizes net revenue retention off the 90% floor.
bullish_points: Deep value on cash flow: ~$356M FCF and forward P/E ~3.8 against a ~$1.26B market cap (~28% FCF yield)
Meaningful insider conviction: net +833k shares purchased over 6 months (25% buy vs 0.2% sell)
86% gross margins and 20% operating margins — the underlying model is still highly profitable
Q2 beat and full-year revenue guide nudged up ($1.207-1.217B); cost cuts (~20% of workforce) protect FCF
bearish_points: Core existential AI risk: contact/intelligence data is exactly the layer buyers may replace with internal LLM tooling
Net revenue retention stuck at 90% for three straight quarters — no upsell traction
Revenue growth ~1%; consumption-pricing transition is a near-term revenue headwind
Pending securities class action; high debt ($1.5B, D/E 183, current ratio 0.65); dossier news feed was empty (no fresh headline confirmation)
catalyst: Stabilization of net revenue retention and evidence GTM.AI/consumption model re-accelerates growth rather than cannibalizing seats
suggested_trade: Spot only, small starter. Wait for NRR to inflect off 90% before adding.
key_risk: AI structurally shrinks demand for third-party GTM data, turning the cheap multiple into a value trap with permanently declining revenue.
would_skip_if: NRR keeps sliding below 90% or consumption transition drives a guidance cut at Q3.
